name: extract_title_author
description: Find the title and the author of one Tibetan work from its first and last parts. Returns exact substrings of the text and which block (head or tail) each came from. Use when you have the text of a Tibetan book, article or manuscript and need its title and author.

text_head.description: The first 3,000 characters of the work, or the whole work if it has 6,000 characters or fewer.

text_tail.description: The last 3,000 characters of the work. Leave empty for a short work.

whole_work.description: True if text_head is the whole work.

needs_review.description: True when free checks doubt the author (about 32% of works; right 56-60% of the time vs 78-79% for the rest).
